body.statement: If \(C_G\) is a forest, the three-state forest-message construction computes every \(F_{\ell,A}\) exactly and hence every \(Q_{\ell}\) in \(L\operatorname{poly}(n,b)\) bit operations, uniformly over all \(|A|\le2\).
body.justification: The forest theorem is a nontrivial solved rung and a falsifiable base case for any separator invariant.
body.gap: Pippenger and Krivelevich et al. study occupancy or expected size on trees, not the complete weighted marked count law needed for exact causal risk.
body.consumer: Village conflict forests receive an exact design selector even if the general fixed-parameter question is negative.
